The abstract describes a multi-agent LLM framework in which the Design agent uses retrieval-augmented generation. It reports that RAG raises answer accuracy on motor design problems from below 50% to 67-80%, so RAG is run as a component and compared against a non-RAG setting. RAG is not the main focus, but the rules cover papers that evaluate a RAG method or compare RAG with other settings. This one does, so it should be included.
